description: Dunit musl port (M6) fs: getdents — directory iteration over the native Readdir. userspace/ctests/musl_dir.c opendir(/app), reads all entries with readdir, finds its own /app/musl_dir, closedir. The adapter snapshots the path-based Readdir in opendir and serializes it into struct dirent records for readdir. Run: tools/qemu_test.py --build --markers-file tools/m6_musl_dir_markers.json --post-boot-delay 3 --settle 4 --cmd-timeout 45 --timeout 160 --boot-timeout 110

required.claim: the system booted to the terminal
opendir+readdir enumerated /app via the native Readdir snapshot
the listing has many entries and includes the program's own name — the getdents adapter works

forbidden.why: opendir failed or the listing was wrong
